steps.name: alerts-0-dots
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py 2>&1 | grep -q ' 0 failed' && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations > /tmp/alerts0p.log 2>&1 && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/alerts0p.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/alerts0p.log && grep -q 'pm_dots(' apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h && grep -q 'PM_DOT_PITCH' apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h && grep -q 'pm_dots(' apps/pomodoro/main.c && ! grep -q 'pm_dots_frame' apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -qE 'define CLK_PICK_MAX +64' main/art/clk_types.h && ORB_CHROME=$(command -v chromium) python3 apps/pomodoro/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py > /tmp/alerts0b.log 2>&1 && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps > /tmp/alerts0a.log 2>&1 && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/alerts-design -- main tools/orb-manager/web apps/pomodoro/version.txt apps/pomodoro/app.json tools/theme_schema.py tools/verify_js_bake.py tools/host_clock3_test.py)" && make check-sandbox

steps.name: alerts-1-backed-ring
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 tools/host_ring_test.py 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && python3 tools/host_ring_test.py --mutations > /tmp/alerts1m.log 2>&1 && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/alerts1m.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/alerts1m.log && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations > /tmp/alerts1p.log 2>&1 && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/alerts1p.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/alerts1p.log && grep -qE 'define ORB_RING_BACKED[[:space:]]+0x04u' main/display/orb_ring.h && grep -qE 'define ORB_RING_FLAGS_MASK[[:space:]]+0x07u' main/display/orb_ring.h && grep -q ORB_RING_BACKED apps/sdk/orb.h && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps > /tmp/alerts1a.log 2>&1 && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/alerts-0-dots -- main/app main/input main/net tools/orb-manager apps/pomodoro/app.json apps/pomodoro/version.txt)" && make check-sandbox

steps.name: alerts-2-lent-press
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 tools/host_press_test.py 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && python3 tools/host_press_test.py --mutations > /tmp/alerts2m.log 2>&1 && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/alerts2m.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/alerts2m.log && python3 tools/host_ring_test.py 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && python3 tools/host_svc_test.py 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && grep -qE 'CAP_PRESS[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*11' main/app/orb_svc.h && grep -q '"press"' main/app/orb_svc.c && grep -q press_claim apps/sdk/binds.json && grep -q press_lent apps/sdk/binds.json && grep -qE 'ORBAPP_SETTINGS_MAX[[:space:]]+18' main/app/orb_app_manifest.h && grep -qE 'SETTINGS_MAX[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*18' tools/orbapp.py && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/alerts-1-backed-ring -- apps/pomodoro)" && make check-sandbox

steps.name: alerts-3-pomodoro-press
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations > /tmp/alerts3p.log 2>&1 && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/alerts3p.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/alerts3p.log && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py build apps/pomodoro > /tmp/alerts3b.log 2>&1 && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps > /tmp/alerts3a.log 2>&1 && grep -q '"press"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && grep -q '"press_any"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/alerts-2-lent-press -- . ':!docs/specs' ':!apps/pomodoro/main.c' ':!apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c' ':!apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h' ':!apps/pomodoro/app.json' ':!tools/host_pomodoro_test.py')" && make check-sandbox
